explicit_limits: This profile is ISO C17 plus a fixture-owned Make build; it does not imply C++, Objective-C, Objective-C++, CUDA, OpenCL, assembly, CMake, Xcode, Bazel, Meson, embedded, kernel, or framework support.

Only .c and .i are profile-owned. A .h or .inc file is C only when a trustworthy C compile command and its dependency closure own it; otherwise it remains ambiguous and shared inventory must not infer C from the suffix.

Makefile presence proves a build marker, not semantic readiness. Cross-translation-unit facts require a valid, current, complete compile_commands.json whose effective commands use C mode; missing, malformed, stale, incomplete, or fallback commands cannot produce a complete semantic outcome.
Clang AST JSON and raw-token output are version-gated feasibility inputs, not stable cross-version APIs or skill final outcomes.

Macro expansion, inactive conditional branches, function pointers, file-local linkage, ABI/layout, generated headers, target/sysroot/defines/include order, freestanding mode, and non-default build variants remain explicit semantic limits.
